issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 08 uses SELECT * and therefore returns all columns from Gemeinde, but the problem statement explicitly instructs to output exactly Name, Landkreis, Fläche and the Einwohnerzahlen. This structural mismatch between the solution and the stated requirement may confuse students (and graders) about which columns are required and contradicts the rule 'Gib immer genau die geforderten Daten aus und nicht mehr.'
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the reference solution to select only the requested columns. Replace SELECT * with SELECT name, kreis, flaeche, einwohner_m, einwohner_w FROM Gemeinde WHERE (einwohner_m > 50000 AND einwohner_w > 50000) OR flaeche > 100 so the solution matches the explicit requirement to output exactly those fields.
